answer: The ripple I would price into every new account is Certified poultry keeper licence with poultry keepers attestation: a licence keepers renew after flock inspections, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a licence keepers renew after flock inspections cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the bridge of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the sable for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
